fields.description: Google's Subscription.uid. Unique so that subscriptions.list can be reconciled against this table in one probe, and so that the 'no ACTIVE subscription for this coworker' alarm cannot be fooled by a duplicate bookkeeping row. Empty until the create call returns; Frappe coerces empty to NULL on a unique DocField, so unwritten rows do not collide.
fields.label: Subscription UID

fields.description: The Google resource the subscription watches, e.g. users/{user} for a per-coworker message subscription.
fields.label: Target Resource

fields.description: The coworker whose grant this subscription runs under. Roughly one subscription per coworker means roughly one independent revocation surface per coworker.
fields.label: Target User

fields.description: Google's Subscription.state, read back rather than assumed. There is no EXPIRED value because Google does not keep expired subscriptions in any state - it deletes them. Expiry is read off expire_time, not off this field.
fields.label: State

fields.description: Google's suspensionReason. USER_SCOPE_REVOKED is not a bug and must never be retried into the ground - it means a coworker revoked their grant, and the correct response is to stop retrying, raise the suspension alarm naming them, and let a human ask.
fields.label: Suspension Reason
fields.options:
USER_SCOPE_REVOKED
RESOURCE_DELETED
USER_AUTHORIZATION_FAILURE
ENDPOINT_PERMISSION_DENIED
ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND
ENDPOINT_RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED
APP_SCOPE_REVOKED
APP_AUTHORIZATION_FAILURE

fields.description: The CloudEvent types this subscription requests, one per line.
fields.label: Event Types

fields.description: Read back from Google after every create and every patch, never computed locally. A patch that silently failed to extend is otherwise invisible until the subscription is already gone. Reactivating a suspended subscription keeps the original expiry, so a suspension does not buy time.
fields.label: Expire Time

fields.description: Consecutive failed renewal or reactivation attempts. Reset to zero on any success.
fields.label: Consecutive Failures
